lead.headline: Serbian president concedes defeat to student-led movement
lead.summary: Serbia's president has acknowledged losing an election to a movement led by students, a striking turn after long-running protests.

stories.headline: Retrofitting language models to operate over bytes
stories.summary: Published in Nature, this work from the Allen Institute for AI and collaborators converts existing subword language models into byte-level ones using under 1% of typical pretraining compute. It is drawing attention because it removes tokenizer limits while approaching the original models' benchmark scores. Only this one qualifying peer-reviewed paper could be verified today.

stories.headline: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies, Apollo economist says
stories.summary: An economist at Apollo argues most companies are seeing no financial return from their AI spending so far.

stories.headline: Grok releases first seven minutes of its AI-generated 'Odyssey'
stories.summary: Grok has published the opening seven minutes of an AI-generated work called Odyssey.

stories.headline: Researchers used a public OpenAI model to build a $250,000 Chrome exploit in six days
stories.summary: Security researchers report using a publicly available OpenAI model to develop a full-chain Chrome exploit in under a week.

stories.headline: Police investigate bullet inscribed with 'RAT' found on Victorian MP's car
stories.summary: Police are investigating a threatening bullet found on the car of Emergency Services Minister Paul Edbrooke.

stories.headline: Essendon sack coach after one-win AFLW season
stories.summary: Essendon has dismissed AFLW coach Natalie Wood with one round left, after the team managed only one win.

stories.headline: Weather ruins MotoGP but Phillip Island goes out on high
stories.summary: Riders and locals farewelled Phillip Island's MotoGP event despite poor weather, marking the end of an era.

stories.headline: Educators weigh a 'digital detox' in schools
stories.summary: Schools overseas are shifting back to analogue learning, though at least one international measure shows no improvement in results yet.

stories.headline: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado returns after months in exile
stories.summary: Machado, a leading Venezuelan opposition figure, has come back to the country after months abroad.

thought: Small steps, taken daily, compile into something remarkable.
